# McLoud Construction

> McLoud Construction is a locally owned, insured remodeling contractor serving the Kansas City
> metro (Missouri and Kansas). It works for three kinds of customers: homeowners (kitchen,
> bathroom, basement, and whole-home remodels), accessibility (aging-in-place bathrooms,
> tub-to-shower conversions, and accessibility modifications), and property managers (unit
> renovations, commercial interior remodels, accessible units, and exterior repairs).
> Stachys McLoud founded McLoud Construction after years in the restoration industry managing
> large projects for Kansas City property management companies. Built right. Told straight.

## Homeowners

- Kitchen remodeling: cabinetry, countertops, layout changes, plumbing, electrical, flooring, and lighting
- Bathroom remodeling: full gut renovations and focused updates, with waterproofing and ventilation done right
- Basement finishing: moisture checks first, then framing, flooring, bedrooms with egress windows, bathrooms, and living space
- Whole-home remodeling: open-concept conversions, multi-room renovations, and full interior overhauls
- Tub-to-shower conversions: tub removal and a new walk-in shower with low-threshold or curbless options

## Accessibility

- Aging-in-place bathroom remodels: curbless showers, grab bars, shower benches, comfort-height toilets, slip-resistant floors
- Tub-to-shower conversions
- Accessibility modifications: ramps, wider doorways, accessible kitchens and bathrooms, accessible entries
- Accessible unit upgrades for property managers: roll-in showers, wider doorways, accessible kitchens and entries

## Property Managers

- Unit renovations and turns: kitchens, baths, flooring, and finishes built to a property standard
- Commercial interior remodels: office and retail buildouts, lobbies, clubhouses, leasing offices, church and community spaces
- Accessible unit upgrades
- Multi-family renovations: units, amenities, and exteriors for apartment communities
- Exterior work: repaints, wood rot and trim replacement, stucco repairs

## Service Area

Greater Kansas City metro, including communities on both the Missouri and Kansas sides:
Kansas City, Lee's Summit, Independence, Blue Springs, Liberty, and Raymore in Missouri;
Overland Park, Olathe, Lenexa, Shawnee, Leawood, and Kansas City, KS in Kansas.
